question: Does the existing bounded adaptive-feature ANN80k result improve the frozen targeted7 mapper when compared on the same snapshot base and mapper settings?

ann_source.note: The earlier ANN mapper used a different pre-targeted7 base, so its trajectory failure was not an apples-to-apples rejection of retrieval.

snapshot_union.complexity: sparse union only; no image-pair Cartesian product

ordering_diagnostic.reason: All newly appended ANN pairs lie after the frozen 59961-pair structure prefix. They can contribute to deferred registration and post-registration completion, but not initial track construction.
ordering_diagnostic.conclusion: The same-base union closes reprojection slightly but cannot test ANN support as a pose/scale constraint and regresses both trajectory aggregates. Do not promote this arm.

frozen_track_extension_probe.contract: Against the frozen 59961-pair structure graph, admit only matches with exactly one endpoint in an established track and one singleton endpoint; never merge established tracks, never duplicate an image within a track, cap each established track at one extension, insert admitted pairs before the targeted7 deferred tail.
frozen_track_extension_probe.conclusion: Even one-sided frozen-track topology is not a sufficient alias-rejection signal in the repeated corridor. The probe failed the registration and trajectory gates; it remains only as an explicit diagnostic utility mode and is not part of the mapper or promoted pipeline.

next_action: Do not promote adaptive VLAD candidates using graph-membership or cycle support alone. The next structure constraint needs independent geometric evidence, such as rotation-consistent multi-path support plus wide-baseline triangulation validation, before it can influence pose estimation.
